LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsEnvoyTree_Report: A Rakinian envoy arrived bearing a royal procurement order.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Envoy_Greeting: "Greetings, {Interviewer_labelShort}. I am a herald of His Majesty's Quartermaster Corps, dispatched from Rakinia. Word of your settlement's armaments has reached the royal court, and we come bearing an invitation to serve the crown."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Envoy_Terms1: "The terms are straightforward. Deliver a batch of blades of 'Good' quality or better within the set deadline. In return, the kingdom offers a generous sum of silver, and a royal token—a writ of conscription, sealed in our name."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Envoy_Terms2: "The kingdom is at war, and we want tools that won't fail us. Deliver a good batch, and more orders will follow."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Envoy_Sealed: The envoy gives a curt nod, rolls the contract, and secures it with a wax seal. "Done. Our quartermaster will come to inspect and collect on the agreed date. Do not disappoint."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Arms_Envoy_MsgAccept: You have accepted the royal procurement order. Prepare weapons of 'Good' or better quality for the quartermaster's visit.
